issue.title: Block recording on chapters at Complete stage.
issue.body:
Block recording on chapters at Complete stage (mobile)

Description

Once a chapter reaches the Complete stage, it should no longer be recordable on mobile. Currently nothing prevents recording at that stage. #550 only gated the stage-advance CTA and did not add a recording lock.

A future change will allow a completed chapter to be rerun through translation, but that is out of scope here.

Reported by

QA (@Roslin22), in the #550 test results ([l[ink to comment: PASTE HERE](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/542#issuecomment-5866279115)]) , issue 2, “Recording allowed after completion”:

After the chapter is moved to the Advanced Checks stage and the chapter is marked as complete, the translator is still able to record.

Expected behavior

Once a chapter is at Complete, it should not be recordable anymore. Rerunning a completed chapter through translation will be supported later, but not now.

Related

Refs #542 / #550. This ticket covers only issue 2 of the QA report.

Acceptance criteria

 When a chapter is at Complete, record and Record New Take are disabled in both verse mode and pericope mode.
 At Complete, delete and select-take controls on existing takes are not shown.
 Playback and scrubbing of existing takes still work at Complete.
 Stages before Complete behave as they do today, including the existing drafter block on open Peer Check.
 Unit tests cover the Complete-stage case.

Out of scope

Re-running a completed chapter through translation (planned later).
Stage-advance CTA behavior (handled in #550).

Refs: #542, #550

Needs QA? Yes, post-merge nightly QA
